adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed`, the code iterates `rss.items.each` and performs operations that can raise per-item exceptions (e.g., `i.content.scrub` will raise if `i.content` is `nil`/non-string; `TopicEmbed.import` appends to `contents`, which will also raise if `contents` isn’t a mutable string). There is no per-item rescue, so a single bad feed entry will raise and abort the entire job, preventing later items from being processed in that run and likely causing repeated failures on subsequent hourly runs.
